# WO-004: Make website FAQ controls easier to read and use
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)
Drafted by: Elena Vasquez (Codex lead); approved by Morgan Reyes 2026-11-07

## Goal
Amara Okoye: audit and improve the shared FAQ disclosure component
for older readers using keyboard navigation, zoom, and small screens.
One or two sessions.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Retain native details/summary controls and the existing items/openFirst
  API, IDs, answer rendering, and initial open states.
- Each summary has a clearly visible keyboard focus indicator and a
  minimum 44 by 44 CSS-pixel target.
- Long questions and answer links wrap without FAQ-caused horizontal
  scrolling at 360px and at 200% zoom on a 1280px viewport.
- Text and focus indicators meet applicable WCAG AA contrast
  requirements in light and dark modes.
- Enter/Space toggles each disclosure; expanded state is announced by
  a screen reader. Record browser and assistive technology used;
  unavailable manual checks remain explicitly unverified.
- No new JavaScript; reduced-motion preference is respected.
- Add built-HTML regression tests for native disclosure structure,
  accessible question text, and initial open states on existing pages.
- Website build, CSP/link/budget checks, and content checks pass;
  report inherited failures separately.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/components/FaqList.astro
- tests/test_web_faq_accessibility.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
FAQ content/data, page files, global styles, tokens, other components,
app code, security, registry/research, CI/release, and WO-002 paths.
Keep styling scoped to this component. No dependencies or network.

## Check-in plan
After session one: report observed defects and proposed scoped fixes.
At completion: provide test results and the light/dark, keyboard,
zoom, and screen-reader verification matrix.
